policy: Human-only actions are accumulated; autonomous technical work continues independently.

actions.action: Complete Clerk Production domain DNS connection for clerk.tigerautoparts.shop and verify Clerk marks the domain/DNS setup complete.
actions.reason: Production Clerk instance exists and key maps to clerk.tigerautoparts.shop, but DNS connection has not been independently verified.

actions.action: In Repository Settings > Pages set Custom domain to tigerautoparts.shop, preferably verify domain ownership first, then configure apex DNS records with the DNS provider. For an Actions-based Pages workflow the repository CNAME file is ignored and does not configure the custom domain.
actions.reason: GitHub Pages API currently reports cname=null and the Pages source is a custom GitHub Actions workflow.

actions.action: Approve the proposed release-workflow hardening design with the exact phrase APPROVE_RELEASE_WORKFLOW_HARDENING so a reviewed change can replace push-to-main deployment with explicit exact-SHA release triggering, pin GitHub Actions to immutable commits, move pages/id-token permissions to the deploy job only, and remove dependency drift in the release job.
actions.reason: Current pages.yml is fail-closed behind human environments but still auto-creates a production release attempt on every main push, uses mutable major action tags, grants deployment permissions at workflow scope, upgrades pip dynamically, and installs pytest unpinned.

actions.action: If Google sign-in is required at launch, configure and verify Clerk Production Google credentials before the release. If launch uses other provider-managed methods only, explicitly mark Google sign-in out of launch scope.
actions.reason: Clerk Production setup showed Google sign-in custom credentials not yet completed; requirement depends on the intended launch authentication methods.

actions.action: Approve a dedicated legacy-credential retirement gate with the exact phrase APPROVE_LEGACY_AUTH_RETIREMENT_DESIGN. The reviewed sequence will disable Supabase email/password authentication, revoke legacy sessions/refresh tokens, preserve public.profiles, and retire the seven legacy Supabase Auth credentials without auto-linking profiles by email.
actions.reason: Production still contains 7 email/password Auth users with encrypted passwords and 4 non-revoked refresh tokens, while the binding architecture requires federated identity only. The current repository runtime no longer uses Supabase password auth, so this is a historical credential surface rather than a current code path.

actions.action: After identity credential retirement, approve a separate legacy browser-surface minimization design if the old tables are no longer required by any external consumer. The design should revoke unnecessary anon/authenticated SQL privileges while preserving only explicitly public catalog reads.
actions.reason: Sensitive legacy tables currently contain zero rows and anonymous read proof exposes zero sensitive rows, but several old tables still grant broad SQL privileges and rely on RLS as the sole boundary. Current H2 runtime uses the new vvip_marketplace_* substrate instead.

actions.action: Only after all blocking prerequisites and approved hardening are reverified, send exactly APPROVE_PRODUCTION_RELEASE_EXACT.
actions.reason: This is the separate sovereign authorization for exact Production Phase B migration, postflight proof, and exact release workflow trigger. It does not authorize country activation, persistent owner seeding or real user/business data mutation.

actions.action: When an authorized production run is waiting, sign in as nzuodezuode-byte and approve production-build only after PRG reports the exact run/SHA as expected.
actions.reason: Prevent self-review is enabled and the triggering technical account cannot approve its own protected environment.

actions.action: Approve github-pages as nzuodezuode-byte only after the build manifest and source SHA are verified green for the same authorized run.
actions.reason: The deploy environment is an independent second human gate and administrator bypass is disabled.
